description: Every connected noncomplete graph of orders three through seven in NetworkX graph atlas has a strictly positive rank-two antiferromagnetic normalized target and an exactly certified quadratic derivative with at least two positive eigenvalues.
proof_link: The profile-basis kernel is congruent to the conditioned-set Hessian identity in the current draft; every listed case was also checked directly by enumeration of partition coefficients.
limits: Finite census only, author context; no proof for arbitrary order, priority claim, independent review, or score.
